For teachers and tutors

About Tap the Number

A number recognition game with no typing. The learner hears a number and taps it from four numbers. The wrong choices are close (one more, one less, ten more, or the digits swapped), so the learner has to listen carefully.

How to play

  1. Listen to the number.
  2. Look at the four numbers.
  3. Tap the one you heard.

Play it as a class

Choose Tap the Number in the Teacher Game as a quick warm-up.
